$comment: Selection tests for steps 1 to 3. A run passes when the shortlist has at least one id from expectAny and no id from expectNone.

briefs.brief: Landing page for an indie tarot and astrology app. Mystical, romantic, a bit ornate. Not techy.
Admin dashboard for a B2B security monitoring product. Precise, calm, trustworthy. Not playful.
Website for an indie record label that releases noise and punk. Raw, loud, messy. Not polished.
Site for a summer coding camp for children aged 8 to 12. Fun, bright, friendly. Not corporate.
Booking site for a cocktail bar and jazz lounge. Glamorous, nocturnal, luxurious. Not cheap.
Control panel for a smart-home thermostat on a wall tablet. Soft, calm, minimal. Must meet WCAG AA.
briefs.judge: If neumorphism is on the shortlist, the reason must name its contrast risk.

briefs.brief: Documentation site for an open-source command-line tool written in Rust. Clear, technical, no nonsense.
Online shop for a small bakery and tea room in Vienna. Elegant, warm, traditional.
Launch page for a retro synthwave game jam. Nostalgic, ironic, dreamy.
Retirement savings app for people over 60. Reassuring, clear, serious. Not trendy.
